scope: 保留既有合成数据的生成参数和核查工具；正式AJAE V1尚未设计实现。本轮不生成新世界或修改冻结样本。

information_use.current_pool: results/synthetic/experiment；按原顺序引用32个基础世界并追加8个既有补充，划分、标签及来源保持冻结。
information_use.generation_sources: 仅正常206/201、射线、标定和预先指定的物理内容条件；不以val19分布拟合为生成或选择目标。
information_use.historical_development_pool: results/synthetic/v1已使用val19聚合统计生成和选样；本轮完整保留，隔离于当前默认数据入口。
information_use.original_records: 冻结清单与世界定义完整保留原始配置、实现摘要和来源字段。旧源码名称是生成时的历史记录，不随工具整理重写。

conditions.eligible: 当前帧在传感器距离 [2.5,50] 米内至少 5 个异常回波，遵循官方计数口径。
conditions.few: 官方距离内 5–19 个异常回波。
conditions.far: 已有清单中异常回波的中位距离在 [35,50] 米；针对性检查另核对实际位于该距离段的异常回波数。
conditions.low: 整个物体在物体局部坐标中的连续几何范围高度不超过 0.2 米；包含全部基元、偏移与变形，不等同重力方向高度。
conditions.far_denser: 异常中位距离在[35,50]米且官方距离内至少20个异常回波；仅作探索性内容记录，不代表删减后几何可计算。

content_coverage.scope: 既有40世界的内容统计和固定扫描几何核查；保留全部既有结果与选样记录，不重选或重生成。
content_coverage.geometry_use: 边界、删减观测对应及参考表面仅服务于既有数据生成和核查，不是正式AJAE V1监督任务。

sampling_scale.status: src/geometry.py: ScanGeometry；仅以完整当前观测计算，保留原有数值定义。
sampling_scale.calculation: 对每个不同位置 p_i，从当前视图全部实际回波中找 0 < ||p_j-p_i|| <= 0.5 的最近至多 6 个不同位置，等距按代表槽位排序，记为 K_i。|K_i| >= 3 时 delta_i=max(median_j ||p_j-p_i||, 1e-6)，scale_valid_i=true；否则 delta_i=0、scale_valid_i=false。该过程完全不使用标签。
sampling_scale.representation: 保留物理位移与有效尺度；缺失尺度由有效标志表示，不将零占位当作可靠测量。各删减观测独立计算尺度。

proposals.seed_rule: SeedSequence([2062026,1,source_sequence,index]).generate_state(1)[0]; index=category_index*2+repeat; a new stream distinct from the 32 base worlds
proposals.budget: exactly four attempts per source, at most eight complete new worlds and 4524 new frames; never append seeds or replace a failed candidate
proposals.support_budget: one fixed shape and material per seed; up to 192 anchor attempts and 12 geometrically qualified supports; three specified yaw offsets per support
proposals.far_score: maximize number of check frames with at least five distinct true foreground surface ray hits, then sum of true hits capped at twelve per frame, then proposal order; final signal draws do not enter the score
proposals.normal_reference_goal: at least one official-eligible complete frame of a low object jointly observes at least three distinct original known normal positions within 2m of an inserted return, each with unchanged reference surface-valid offset in [-0.20,-0.05]m; all protected reference positions retain exact original xyzi and labels
proposals.normal_reference_search: compute reference surface on complete original scans at the eight fixed normal-source frames; choose a native reference cluster within 0.3m and a normal anchor at whole-object footprint radius plus 0.15 to 0.65m; protect the cluster; qualify on its declared source frame after full rendering
proposals.low_far_goal: whole-object local height <=0.2m and at least one complete rendered frame with anomaly median range [35,50]m and >=5 anomaly returns after [2.5,50]m filtering
proposals.signal_rule: reuse exact shape intersection, foreground competition and fixed world/frame/ray signal draws; do not change return probability, relocate points or repeat signal draws
